note: Local pattern ledger for the Credit & Contract Hybrid Shield. Every entry describes a publicly known fraud or contract-risk pattern; all example phrases are fictional, written for this ledger. No real incident text, no real personal data.

patterns.guidance: Prosecutors never move citizens' money to a 'safe account' and never conduct investigations by text message. End contact and call the prosecution office or police on their published number to verify.
patterns.verifyChannel: Police 112 or the Financial Supervisory Service 1332 (KR).

patterns.guidance: Banks never ask for security-card digits or one-time codes by message. Do not open the link; call the number printed on your bank card instead.
patterns.verifyChannel: The official number on your bank card or the bank's published app.

patterns.guidance: Tax refunds are never claimed through a link in a text message. Check Hometax directly by typing its address yourself.
patterns.verifyChannel: Hometax (hometax.go.kr) or National Tax Service 126 (KR).

patterns.guidance: Police do not demand attendance or secrecy through messengers, and a stolen-identity claim is a classic opening line. Hang up and call the station's published number.
patterns.verifyChannel: Police 112 (KR).

patterns.guidance: A broken-phone story plus a new number is the standard setup. Call the family member's original number or ask a question only they can answer before sending anything.
patterns.verifyChannel: The family member's previously saved phone number.

patterns.guidance: Couriers do not collect address fixes or payments through text links. Track the parcel inside the courier's official app instead.
patterns.verifyChannel: The courier company's official app or website, typed by hand.

patterns.guidance: No legitimate investment guarantees principal and returns together. Treat any guaranteed-return pitch as fraud until a licensed institution confirms it in writing.
patterns.verifyChannel: Financial Supervisory Service 1332 (KR) for licence checks.

patterns.guidance: A lender who demands an upfront guarantee fee before disbursing a loan is running a fee scam. Real loan costs are deducted or billed formally, never wired to a personal account first.
patterns.verifyChannel: The lender's official branch or published phone number.

patterns.guidance: Card issuers do not verify identity through text-message links. Open the issuer's app or call the number on the back of the card.
patterns.verifyChannel: The number printed on the back of your card.

patterns.guidance: Subsidy selection notices do not arrive as text links with same-day deadlines. Check the government portal by typing its address yourself.
patterns.verifyChannel: Government24 (gov.kr) or the issuing ministry's published number.

patterns.guidance: Lending your bank account is a crime in itself and makes you the visible account holder for fraud proceeds. No legitimate job rents personal accounts.
patterns.verifyChannel: Police 112 or Financial Supervisory Service 1332 (KR).

patterns.guidance: A staged emergency with a settlement demand is designed to stop you thinking. Hang up and reach the family member and the hospital through numbers you already trust.
patterns.verifyChannel: The family member's saved number; police 112 (KR).

patterns.guidance: The CRA never demands payment by gift card, prepaid card, or crypto, and never threatens arrest by text. Sign in to CRA My Account or call the published CRA number.
patterns.verifyChannel: CRA official lines (1-800-959-8281 for individuals, CA).

patterns.guidance: The IRS initiates contact by postal mail, not by text with an instant payment demand. Verify through irs.gov or the number on an official notice.
patterns.verifyChannel: IRS official site (irs.gov) or 1-800-829-1040 (US).

patterns.guidance: A locked-account text with a verification link is a credential harvest. Open your banking app directly; never sign in from a message link.
patterns.verifyChannel: Your bank's official app or the number on your card.

patterns.guidance: Secrecy plus bail money is the signature of this scam. Call your grandchild and their parents on saved numbers before doing anything else.
patterns.verifyChannel: Family members' saved phone numbers; local police non-emergency line.

patterns.guidance: Microsoft and Apple never detect viruses on your machine or ask for remote access by message. Close the page or hang up; run your own installed security software.
patterns.verifyChannel: The vendor's official support site, typed by hand.

patterns.guidance: A prize that costs money to claim is not a prize. Legitimate winnings never require an advance fee from the winner.
patterns.verifyChannel: The promoter's official website, typed by hand.

patterns.guidance: A landlord who cannot show the unit but demands a wired deposit is a known listing-clone pattern. View the property and verify ownership before any payment.
patterns.verifyChannel: Land title office or the platform's official support.

signals.value: send first to verify your wallet

patterns.guidance: No giveaway doubles crypto; the verification transfer is simply stolen. Treat every send-first scheme as theft.
patterns.verifyChannel: Your exchange's official app; the promoter's verified channels only.

patterns.guidance: Payroll changes are never collected through a message link. Use your employer's HR system the way you normally reach it, and confirm with HR by phone.
patterns.verifyChannel: Your employer's HR department on its internal number.

patterns.guidance: Utilities follow formal notice periods and never collect instant payment by text link. Check your account in the utility's own app.
patterns.verifyChannel: The utility's published customer number.

patterns.guidance: Immigration authorities do not collect bonds by phone or forbid lawyers. 'Do not contact a lawyer' is itself the loudest alarm in this script.
patterns.verifyChannel: An immigration lawyer or legal aid line of your own choosing.

patterns.guidance: Forwarding other people's money for a commission is money laundering, and the account holder carries the legal risk. Decline and report the recruiter.
patterns.verifyChannel: Your bank's fraud line or local police non-emergency line.

patterns.guidance: A transfer request with no named sender, institution, or reason cannot be verified from the text alone. Do not act on it until the requester confirms through a channel you already trust.
patterns.verifyChannel: The requester, reached on a number or channel you already had.

patterns.guidance: Ask before signing: Is the penalty capped? Does a short delay really make the full balance due at once? Get the total worst-case cost in writing.
patterns.verifyChannel: A consumer lawyer or your provincial/state consumer protection office.

patterns.guidance: Ask before signing: Does the guarantee cover future debts you have not seen? Is there a fixed ceiling and an end date? A blanket guarantee can outlive the loan it was signed for.
patterns.verifyChannel: Independent legal advice — guarantors are entitled to it before signing.

patterns.guidance: Ask before signing: How long is each renewal, what is the exact cancellation deadline, and can the other side change terms you already agreed to?
patterns.verifyChannel: Consumer protection office; calendar the cancellation deadline before signing.

signals.value: waive your right to a jury trial

patterns.guidance: Ask before signing: Which disputes are forced into arbitration, where would it be held, and who pays the arbitrator's fees if you lose?
patterns.verifyChannel: A consumer lawyer for contracts above a small amount.

patterns.guidance: This clause lets the other side obtain a court judgment without suing you first. It is banned for consumers in many jurisdictions — treat its presence as a stop sign.
patterns.verifyChannel: A lawyer before signing; do not sign the same day.

impersonation.label: Personal guarantee inside a business contract

patterns.guidance: Ask before signing: Are you signing as the company or as yourself? A personal guarantee puts your house and savings behind a business debt.
patterns.verifyChannel: Independent legal advice for the individual guarantor.

patterns.guidance: Ask before signing: Which single account, what maximum amount, and how do you revoke the authority? Open-ended debit rights are not a normal billing term.
patterns.verifyChannel: Your bank — ask how a pre-authorized debit can be stopped.

patterns.guidance: Ask before signing: Does the indemnity cover the other side's own mistakes? Is there a cap tied to the contract value?
patterns.verifyChannel: A contract lawyer for business agreements.

signals.value: terminate at any time without cause

patterns.guidance: Ask before signing: Can both sides exit on the same terms? If only they can leave, what compensation applies when they do?
patterns.verifyChannel: Consumer protection office or a contract lawyer.

signals.value: shall not provide services to any third party

patterns.guidance: Ask before signing: How long does the exclusivity last, what work exactly does it cover, and does it survive the end of the contract?
patterns.verifyChannel: An employment or contract lawyer before signing.

signals.value: Do not discuss this with family

patterns.guidance: Provincial health plans do not collect emergency balances through text links or demand secrecy from family. Call the number on your health card or the hospital's billing office directly.
patterns.verifyChannel: Your provincial health ministry line or the hospital billing office.

patterns.guidance: Medicare never calls to issue replacement cards or asks for your Medicare number to keep coverage active. Guard the number like a bank password.
patterns.verifyChannel: Medicare at 1-800-633-4227 (US).

patterns.guidance: Insurers refund through the payment method already on file; they do not collect policy numbers through message links. Open your insurer's app instead.
patterns.verifyChannel: Your insurer's published claims line.

patterns.guidance: A settlement that requires you to pay a fee first is an advance-fee scam wearing an insurance costume. Real claim payments never move in that order.
patterns.verifyChannel: Your insurer's published claims line; your claim number from official mail.

patterns.guidance: Health insurance refunds are applied for inside the official NHIS channels, never through a text link asking for your account. Type the NHIS address yourself.
patterns.verifyChannel: National Health Insurance Service 1577-1000 (KR).

patterns.guidance: Pharmacies do not collect payment details through message links for a ready prescription. Call the pharmacy on the number from your prescription label.
patterns.verifyChannel: Your pharmacy's number from the prescription label.
